surface: mid dive, the first turn the player is carrying a bought patch cell
intent: Clicking any slag block burns the carried cell into a live cross junction for 1 RAM. It is single use, so the player should learn to save it for a wall they cannot route around rather than spend it on the first slag block they see.
constraints: 2 lines max, 160 chars each, no em or en dashes, terminal voice, second person.
title: PATCH CELL
lines: You are carrying a cell. Click a slag block within reach to burn it into a live junction for 1 RAM.
One use, then it is gone. Save it for the wall you cannot route around, not the first slag you see.
